claims.text: US President Donald Trump stated at a rally in Garden City, New York, that he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory.
Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi rejected Donald Trump's remarks and stated that the Strait of Hormuz would remain under Iranian control.
The United States and Israel launched a war against Iran on February 28.
Prior to the war, one-fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas passed through the Strait of Hormuz.
Donald Trump told rally attendees that no ships pass through the US blockade of the Strait of Hormuz unless the United States wants them to.
Two oil tankers operated by Abu Dhabi's state-owned oil company ADNOC were attacked by drones in the Strait of Hormuz.
The United Arab Emirates accused Iran of piracy following drone attacks on two ADNOC tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
In June, the United States and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding to halt military operations during the war.
A Quinnipiac University poll from late July found that 60 percent of US voters oppose US military action against Iran.
Iranian officials stated that Tehran will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz unless the US lifts sanctions, compensates for war damage, and releases frozen assets.
Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty without a plea deal in federal court to two charges of stalking UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson with intent to kill him.
Luigi Mangione stated in court: 'I shot Mr. Thompson in Manhattan and he died.'
UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson was shot and killed on December 4, 2024, outside a Midtown Manhattan hotel hosting an investor conference.
Federal prosecutors stated they will seek a sentence of life in prison for Luigi Mangione at his December 18 sentencing.
Lawyers for Luigi Mangione filed a motion to dismiss separate New York state murder and weapons charges based on double jeopardy principles.
In January 2026, US District Judge Margaret Garnett dismissed federal murder and weapons charges against Luigi Mangione on legal technicalities.
Luigi Mangione was arrested five days after the shooting at a McDonald's restaurant in Altoona, Pennsylvania.
State Judge Gregory Carro dismissed state terrorism charges against Luigi Mangione in September 2025.
Wildfires fueled by heat and drought burned approximately 500,000 hectares across Europe.
A wildfire near Omis, Croatia, killed one person, injured 40 people, and forced 1,200 people to evacuate.
More than 300 people were evacuated by boat from the seaside town of Siviri in northern Greece due to approaching wildfires.
French authorities evacuated 525 people from the village of Luglon in the Landes region due to a wildfire.
A wildfire in Huelva, Spain, burned 31,000 hectares and forced the evacuation of 700 people.
More than 2,000 people were evacuated from the village of Gey in western Germany as a forest fire advanced toward the area.
French authorities have detained 474 people, including 183 minors, on suspicion of starting wildfires since July 1.
A Spanish army unit removed the remains of three 11th-century Aragonese kings from the San Juan de la Peña monastery to protect them from an approaching wildfire.
The Trump administration filed an emergency petition asking the US Supreme Court to allow construction on the $400 million White House ballroom to continue.
On August 7, the US Court of Appeals for the DC Circuit ruled 2-1 to halt above-ground construction of the White House ballroom without congressional approval.
Chief Justice John Roberts ordered plaintiffs challenging the White House ballroom project to file a response by Tuesday.
The National Trust for Historic Preservation initiated the lawsuit against the ballroom project after the White House East Wing was demolished.
US Solicitor General D. John Sauer stated in a Supreme Court filing that construction on the White House ballroom project is 65 percent complete.
Solicitor General D. John Sauer stated that a 250-person crew is working 20 hours a day, seven days a week on the White House ballroom construction.
American missionary pilot Kevin Rideout was released after being held captive in Niger for over nine months.
Kevin Rideout was abducted in Niamey, Niger, on October 21 by three armed individuals.
Kevin Rideout had worked as a missionary in Niger for 19 years prior to his kidnapping.
Christian NGO SIM International announced that Kevin Rideout is in good health and in the care of US officials.
Reports indicate Kevin Rideout was transferred to FBI custody following his release.
President Droupadi Murmu addressed the nation on the eve of India's 80th Independence Day.
The full version of the national song Vande Mataram was played before and after President Droupadi Murmu's address.
President Droupadi Murmu stated that the government is taking comprehensive steps to reform the public examination system to eliminate unfair practices.
Twenty Tamil Nadu police personnel were awarded the President's Medal for Distinguished Service and the Medal for Meritorious Service.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will lead the 80th Independence Day celebrations from the Red Fort.
The Centre enacted the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Act, 2026, on July 31, imposing up to 10 years imprisonment and ₹50 lakh fine for individual exam cheating.
Seventeen Delhi Police personnel were named for Independence Day service medals.
Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif warned that Pakistan's water rights under the Indus Waters Treaty are a 'red line'.
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah criticized Shehbaz Sharif's remarks and stated that the Indus Waters Treaty has 'sucked our blood'.
India placed the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance following the April 22, 2025 terror attack in Pahalgam that killed 26 people.
India launched Operation Sindoor targeting terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoJK following the Pahalgam terror attack.
Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that India's position on the Indus Waters Treaty remains unchanged.
The Indian government notified 40 questions for Phase 2 of Census 2027.
Phase 2 of Census 2027 will record caste as declared by the respondent.
New fields in the Census 2027 questionnaire include number of bank accounts, place of Covid-19 vaccination, mobile phone number, Aadhaar number, and voter card number.
Phase 2 population enumeration begins on August 17 in Ladakh and snow-bound areas of Jammu and Kashmir, Uttarakhand, and Himachal Pradesh.
Census 2027 marks the first time in independent India that caste across all communities will be enumerated.
India last conducted a comprehensive population count of all caste groups in 1931.
